header: Pull-request and ordinary master CI intentionally run only the manifest-derived TS invocation. The tag release workflow runs the Rust invocation through scripts/run-rust-hermetic-e2e.sh on an explicitly enabled private-source runner; it requires sibling path-deps (../commons and ../subconscious).

OpenCode v2 lane: /ctx-flush through the real TUI keymap command must make the NEXT request a priced pass that applies the queued work, read from the plugin's own per-pass decision log with the preceding turns as the control; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2) and joins the release gates when the v2 hooks slice lands, not through the v1 mode-selected spawn seam

OpenCode v2 lane: the GA command domain lists the /ctx-* definitions and executes one over HTTP with no terminal UI running at all, so the commands are reachable from `opencode run`, the API and Desktop; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2) and joins the release gates when the v2 hooks slice lands, not through the v1 mode-selected spawn seam

OpenCode v2 lane: /ctx-wrapup executed over the GA command API runs the historian through the v2 hidden-completion executor and publishes compartments; before the fix wrapup fell back to the v1 executor, which has no client on 2.x; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)

OpenCode v2 lane: the host writes an instruction update (changed AGENTS.md) as a session_message system row it never serves by id; a /ctx-wrapup cut and a compartment stored by an older build both end on that row, and the HARD pass plus two defers after it must serve a byte-stable prefix with no degraded injection and no covered row served raw; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)

OpenCode v2 lane: a user image attached inline or by file URI, and the turns after it, must reach the provider with Magic Context loaded; OpenCode 2.0.15 rebuilds the context draft with a schema that accepts only its own Media.Asset instance, so a plain-object copy of the attachment fails the turn with 'Schema validation failed'. It also covers an image restored from before a host compaction checkpoint, in the same process and after a host restart, which must reach the provider byte-identical to the host's own rendering. The v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2)

OpenCode v2 lane: OpenCode 2 has no command.execute.before hook, so the TUI keymap layer is the only source of a /ctx-* command; asserts the real TUI's own record of the slash names the host accepted; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2) and joins the release gates when the v2 hooks slice lands, not through the v1 mode-selected spawn seam
Real GA OpenCode 2 context-hook lane; invoked separately from v1 TS and Rust

OpenCode v2 lane: the three Dreamer tasks that need no tool loop (review-user-memories, evaluate-smart-notes, promote-primers) run on the pinned GA host against the mock provider; the v2 lane runs from its own invocation (bun test tests/opencode2) and joins the release gates when the v2 hooks slice lands, not through the v1 mode-selected spawn seam
